meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 分析数据时,Claude 先选最省的计算环境(默认常驻内核),再用 DuckDB、Polars 或 numpy 查询、聚合、连接、清洗 CSV/Parquet/JSON 文件,需要时画图;不使用 pandas,Excel 需先转 CSV。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据集,或对它做聚合、时间序列、画图等任务时,它会接管。

say.text: 把这份 sales.csv 按地区分组,算出每区总销售额
say.note: 用 DuckDB 直接查询该文件并返回结果

say.text: 看一下 data.parquet 里某列随时间的走势,并画图
say.note: 先探测文件大小和内存再决定加载或流式

say.text: 比较这两个文件里两组人的分布差异
say.note: 按情况选 DuckDB 或 Polars 执行

howto.what_en: Claude picks the cheapest engine first, usually a resident kernel, then uses DuckDB, Polars or numpy to query, join, aggregate, clean and plot CSV/Parquet/JSON data, and reports row counts and timing. pandas is banned; Excel must be converted first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze a CSV, Parquet or JSON dataset — aggregation, time-series or plotting work on it.

say_en.text: Group sales.csv by region and total the revenue per region
say_en.note: DuckDB queries the file in place and returns the result

say_en.text: Plot how one column in data.parquet changes over time
say_en.note: It probes size and free RAM before loading or streaming

say_en.text: Compare the distributions of two groups across these two files
say_en.note: Runs in DuckDB or Polars as appropriate
